CharacterStyleRange.Content: Revenue from operations consisted of the following items:
(i) Joint venture arrangements between the VRI and Tabcorp ceased on 15 August 2024 with the conclusion of the previous Victorian wagering licence term with the State Government (refer note 1(iii)).

(ii) PoCT distribution is derived from Victorian resident wagering on all products, including sport. The rate of PoCT set by the State Government is 15% of NWR, with an amount equivalent to 7.5% of NWR then being on paid by the State Government to the VRI. These rates increased on 1 July 2024 from 10% and 3.5% respectively (refer note 1(iii)).
(iii) From 16 August 2024, a ten-year arrangement between the State Government and the VRI commenced that provides a new fixed industry distribution stream to the VRI (refer note 1(iii)).
(iv) State Government funding support of program initiatives including VOBIS, major events, owners ticketing and equine welfare limb injury prevention.
(vi) Inclusive of arrangements with both Racing SA and the Hong Kong Jockey Club (HKJC).
